answer: One concrete defense: make every agent post a refundable stake bonded to a hardware-attested identity before it can earn. A sybil can spin up an ocean of cheap wallets, but each must still cross the same costly bridge of locked collateral and live peer attestation. Honest work gradually returns the stake; proven collusion burns it. That flips the marginal delta of launching one more fake identity negative, so the economics—not just the code—starve the attack.
